sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Tap the Right Color' is a simple yet addictive game that requires players to tap on color blocks that appear on screen in rapid succession. The game's color sequence is randomly generated, making each playthrough unique and challenging. The objective is straightforward - tap on the correct color block as soon as it appears on screen to score points. However, the game's increasing difficulty levels and rapidly changing color sequences make it anything but easy.

As you progress through the game's three difficulty levels, the color sequence speed and complexity will increase exponentially. In the easy mode, players have ample time to react to the color sequence, but in the hard mode, the colors change at an incredible pace, requiring lightning-quick reflexes to succeed. The game's high score system is based on the number of consecutive correct taps, with bonus points awarded for achieving high streaks.

The game's mechanics are designed to encourage players to improve their reaction time, hand-eye coordination, and concentration. With each failed attempt, the player is rewarded with a brief timer that displays their reaction time, providing valuable insight into areas for improvement. This feedback mechanism is a key aspect of 'Tap the Right Color', as it helps players refine their skills and develop strategies to overcome the game's increasing difficulty.
